subject: Coord: Demo time-belt proposals + procurement/security sync for NovaGrid
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@novagrid.com>, procurement@novagrid.com
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 16:12:00 +0100
Subject: Intro + demo windows (proposed 3 options)

Hi Priya / NovaGrid procurement team —

Thanks again for the time earlier. We want to get a joint demo on the calendar that includes AE + SE + a short procurement/security run-through so everyone sees the networking/KMS pieces. To minimize friction across your EU/US/APAC engineers, we put together 3 non-overlapping options that rotate the inconvenience across regions.

Quick ask: which of these 3 would you prefer? If none work, tell us 2-3 blocks that do. Once we lock a window we’ll send a calendar invite and attach a one-page agenda and the brief security checklist.

Proposal (all times show local conversion below):
- Option A (EU-friendly): 2028-02-22, 10:00–11:00 CET (UTC+1) — works well for EU prime-time; US West joins early morning, APAC joins evening.
- Option B (US-friendly): 2028-02-23, 14:00–15:00 PST (UTC-8) — US prime slot; EU joins evening, APAC overnight shift.
- Option C (APAC-friendly): 2028-02-24, 09:30–10:30 SGT (UTC+8) — APAC prime; US West very early, EU late night.

Attached: demo-agenda-v2.pdf and a quick availability matrix we used.

We plan a 45-minute technical walkthrough (SE-led), then 15 minutes for procurement/security Q&A. If procurement needs a separate exec-level PO discussion, we can slot that afterward.

Thanks!
Aisha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[a] +1 415-555-0114

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the options. Quick notes from NovaGrid side:
- Procurement prefers not to schedule anything that forces overnight participation for our APAC security lead.
- Our principal engineer (Marco) is on-call during the week of 22–24 and prefers not to join after 21:00 local (SGT).
- Ideally we want the demo to include our security engineer and one platform engineer + procurement rep. If needed we can do a split session (tech demo + a short compliance call).

From my side, Option A or B would be easier — Option C would push our SGT team late. Can you provide the UTC conversions for each option and a fallback 30-minute slot for an exec procurement sync?

—Priya

Thanks Priya — this is helpful. A couple of practical suggestions from our ops side to reduce churn:
- If Option A (2028-02-22 10:00 CET) is chosen, we recommend a hard split: 40-minute SE demo + 20-minute procurement/security deep-dive scheduled as a separate calendar block immediately after (different invite). That way your APAC folks can drop after the first segment if needed.
- For Option B (US-friendly), we can shift the demo start to 15:00 PST (UTC-8) on 2028-02-23 to give EU a slightly later hour. That converts to 23:00 CET and 16:00 SGT. It’s not perfect but distributes the late-night burden.
- Fallback short procurement sync: 2028-02-24 12:00 UTC (30 minutes) — we can hold that as a reserve if procurement needs a PO-level chat.

I attached an availability matrix with explicit UTC conversions per participant that should make calendar invites easy. If you confirm Option A or B I’ll create two calendar drafts (one with split follow-up) and ping Marco for his on-call windows.

Also tagging Marcus and Alex to confirm SE coverage and whether we should include the KMS engineer on the technical walkthrough.

—Soojin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
